recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-38955 unless OO opens a new issue to change obs-7 semantics rather than this description clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-38955 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction for FHIR-core Observation asking whether the obs-7 constraint expression/table text should be more specific about the coding element. The accepted resolution changed the description to explicitly say that if Observation.component.code is the same as Observation.code, then Observation.value SHALL NOT be present because Observation.component.value[x] holds the value.
initial_application: Jira records the change as applied by HL7/fhir commit a70a01bf43cb32a847f54ff77b39634778703167. That commit changed source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml obs-7 human text from the older ambiguous value-element wording to the accepted Observation.value and Observation.component.value[x] wording, while leaving the existing coding-intersection FHIRPath expression unchanged.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml is in current build scope. Current source still has the accepted human text and the expression compares component.code.coding to %resource.code.coding. Later obs-7 source history touches other invariant work but not this FHIR-38955 correction. Older obs-7 Jira issues found during search are historical background, and community searches did not reveal a conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already implements the accepted description and the existing expression is already coding-specific.
